  • Method Details

    • persist

      void persist(org.osgi.framework.BundleContext bundleContext, ResourceContextInfo[] resourceContextInfos)
      Store in the context file the provided resource contexts.

      Persistence policies:

      • All contexts are persisted including the
        invalid reference 
        ResourceMonitoringService#SYSTEM_CONTEXT_NAME
        Resource Context and the
        invalid reference 
        ResourceMonitoringService#FRAMEWORK_CONTEXT_NAME
        Resource Context
      • For each context, the following fields are persisted:
        • the Resource Context name.
        • the bundle ids associated to the context
      • this method should be called when the
        invalid reference 
        ResourceMonitoringService
        is stopping.
      Parameters:
      bundleContext - bundle context to be used to get a file in the private storage area of the
      invalid reference 
      ResourceMonitoringService
      bundle.
      resourceContextInfos - resource contexts to be persisted.

    • load

      ResourceContextInfo[] load(org.osgi.framework.BundleContext context)
      Load from the context file the persisted resource context.
      Parameters:
      context - the bundle context to be used to load the persisted file.
      Returns:
      persisted resource context
